entities.summary: Robert Selmer Bergland was an American politician. He served as a member of the House of Representatives from Minnesota's 7th congressional district from 1971 to 1977. He also served as U.S. Secretary of Agriculture during the Jimmy Carter administration from 1977 to 1981.
